confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for the July 2026 window from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence. Beer assumes domestic lager at ordinary bars, since draught is less common. Cocktail (about 1.7x beer) and wine (about 2x beer) are set from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak, reflecting Indonesia's alcohol taxes. Hostel and hotel anchors have the widest range given listing variation and July peak season. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries citing RBA pages; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparison city. Yogyakarta is placed as a budget-to-mid-range Indonesian tourist city, priced below Bali's resort areas and close to other Javanese cities such as Solo and Malang. Accommodation and restaurant tiers are reasoned from general Southeast Asian budget-destination norms.
